prd.oneLiner: Connect return intake, eligibility, shipment, inspection, refund or exchange, restock or disposition, customer notices, and reverse-logistics outcomes.
prd.goal: Reduce return-processing lead time while improving recoverable-inventory yield and the accuracy of customer return-status updates.
prd.whyNow: Return requests, shipping, inspection, refund or exchange, and inventory status are disconnected, leaving customers without visibility and operators unable to trace loss causes.
prd.problem: Return requests, shipping, inspection, refund or exchange, and inventory status are disconnected, leaving customers without visibility and operators unable to trace loss causes.
prd.solution: Connect return intake, eligibility, shipment, inspection, refund or exchange, restock or disposition, customer notices, and reverse-logistics outcomes.
prd.alternatives: Email, chat, spreadsheets, and manual ledgers
prd.differentiator: Manage intake, processing, and operations data as one connected source of truth.

targets.name: Customer requesting a return or exchange and sales operations practitioner
targets.needs: Quickly register needed work and know its status.
targets.pain: Return requests, shipping, inspection, refund or exchange, and inventory status are disconnected, leaving customers without visibility and operators unable to trace loss causes.

targets.name: Returns, logistics, and customer-support operations coordinator
targets.needs: Manage priority and history and review operations metrics.
targets.pain: Return requests, shipping, inspection, refund or exchange, and inventory status are disconnected, leaving customers without visibility and operators unable to trace loss causes.

targets.name: System and policy administrator
targets.needs: Manage access, policy, and audit history.
targets.pain: Return requests, shipping, inspection, refund or exchange, and inventory status are disconnected, leaving customers without visibility and operators unable to trace loss causes.

scenarios.text: An operational user registers required work and checks its status.
An operator processes queued work and handles exceptions.
System and policy administrator reviews policy and access.
System and policy administrator reviews audit records and operating metrics.

prd.northStar: Share of operations requests completed on time

kpis.name: On-time processing rate
kpis.target: Reduce return-processing lead time while improving recoverable-inventory yield and the accuracy of customer return-status updates.
kpis.method: Monthly aggregation of state changes against target dates

kpis.name: Operations visibility
kpis.method: Share of records connected to reporting

inScope: Order, return reason, item condition, exchange, and refund-request registration
Return number, shipment, inspection, refund, exchange, inventory, and customer-notice history lookup
Return eligibility validation, return-method selection, receipt inspection, refund or exchange approval, restock, and disposition handling
Return rate, reason, processing time, refund, exchange, inventory recovery, and returns-cost reporting
Order, return reason, item condition, exchange, and refund-request registration validation and duplicate prevention
nonGoals: Replacing adjacent systems such as accounting or payroll
assumptions: User and organization data are available through company SSO.
Operators manage policy and classification criteria.
risks: Weak initial classification can cause incorrect processing.
Stale source data can reduce operational trust.
openQuestions: What defines urgent processing and approval?
What are the post-completion verification and reopen rules?
constraints: State, owner, and priority changes require audit logs.
Permission, policy, and state changes require audit logs.
